summary: Frontend Playwright verification of the DJ 'Reply to all locations' broadcast toggle on /social/{slug}. All 7 criteria passed. Guest sees no toggle; DJ (ff_dj_profile in localStorage) sees toggle, can flip aria-pressed false→true, label changes to 'Broadcasting to all locations'. POST /api/wall/posts body captured — user_id equals DJ profile id (57cae364-b31f-4920-909f-fda18fc78fe6) and broadcast_all=true. Backend responded 200 with count=8. Toast 'Broadcast sent to 8 locations' rendered (data-testid=broadcast-toast) within ~200ms. Toggle reset to aria-pressed=false. Broadcast badges (data-testid=post-broadcast-badge) visible in the current feed AND on midtown-atlanta feed, confirming fan-out.

issues: Label uses uppercase CSS transform; tests should compare case-insensitively. Not a bug, just a note.

critical_code_review_comments: SocialWallPage.jsx is ~1400+ lines and mixes 6 sub-components (FeedTab, ChatTab, DMsTab, LiveTab, LiveChat, WhosHereTab, DJStatusBanner, main). Consider splitting into separate files for maintainability.

handlePost reads ff_dj_profile from localStorage inside submit — the DJ id could also be surfaced via userProfile (single source of truth) instead of re-parsing localStorage; current approach works but duplicates the DJ-detection logic already in the profile loader.
seed_data_creation: None. Broadcast created ~8 posts across all locations during the test run; badges remain in feed for future runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Broadcast feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend broadcast branch in wall.py + frontend fix to send ff_dj_profile.id as user_id (SocialWallPage.jsx lines 127-139) both verified. Payload assertion via page.on('request') confirmed correct DJ id sent; response returned {count:8, posts:[...]} across all 8 locations. Broadcast toast auto-dismisses after 3.5s — poll within that window if verifying again.
